title: Biderivations of Null-Filiform and Filiform Zinbiel Algebras
summary: A biderivation of an algebra is a bilinear map which is a derivation in each argument. We describe all biderivations of finite-dimensional complex null-filiform and filiform Zinbiel algebras. For the n-dimensional null-filiform algebra, every biderivation is determined by an arbitrary value at its generating pair; the space of biderivations has dimension n and consists entirely of symmetric maps. For the three standard filiform families, we give explicit bases and determine their symmetric and skew-symmetric parts.
